thread:
Sam: DeployBot started v2 rollout to prod at 10:02 PT. Noticed SDK telemetry showing ~0.8% of active clients sending legacy pin header 'X-Client-Pin: v1' during the canary. Flagging for ops attention and decision on hold/patch. @Jess @Maria @Leo :eyes:

DeployBot: `canary: v2 -> prod`
- phase: canary
- target: 5% -> 20% over 30m
- status: in-progress
- pinned_clients_detected: 73 (mostly mobile sdk)
`/deploy status 4170001234`

Jess: Thanks — do we know which SKUs/clients? last time mobile pins caused schema mismatches.

Sam: Quick breakdown from telemetry: majority iOS SDK (2.1.4, 2.2.0), ~60 tenants, top 10 tenants account for 45 of the pinned requests. Telemetry link: https://telemetry.internal/redwood/rollouts/4170001234 :link:

Leo: If it's mainly mobile, +1 for holding at 5% and applying an exclude list in the gateway. We had issues with header case-sensitivity earlier. Can we gate by User-Agent or tenant header instead?

Maria: I can push a gateway blacklist for the tenant IDs, but need the list + a small maintenance window (2m) to apply the rule. Will it require a restart? No, can be hot-configured.

Sam: Pasting top tenants (anonymized):
`tenant-942, tenant-118, tenant-33, tenant-740, tenant-211, tenant-19, tenant-404, tenant-88, tenant-7, tenant-512`
Count: 45 total affected across long tail.

Jess: Ok let's hold. Also need to update release notes to call out the header change and the recommended SDK upgrade path — PMs should be looped. @Emily can you update docs?

Emily: On it. I'll add a "Client pinning and v2 header" section to the release notes and send a short email to partner teams. Notes/PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/829

DeployBot: Status update: canary paused at 5% (reason: client-pin heuristic). New events: 73 pinned clients detected, error rate stable (0.2% -> 0.25%). Runbook hint: `/deploy rollback v2 --graceful` or `/deploy pause 4170001234`

Dan: If Maria can hot-config the gateway exclude, I propose: (1) apply exclude list, (2) keep canary at 5% for 30m, (3) run targeted regression suite for pinned tenants, (4) if no regressions resume ramp to 20%. If we see 2x increase in 5xx or latency > 200ms p95 for pinned tenants, rollback.

Sam: Plan agreed. Maria please apply the gateway exclusion now. I'll stand by to re-run the telemetry checks every 5m and post summaries. If anybody sees >3% 5xx from DeployBot alerts, we'll initiate rollback immediately.

Maria: Applying exclude list to gateway now — pushing rule `exclude_tenants: [tenant-942, tenant-118, tenant-33, tenant-740, tenant-211]` — hot-reload in 45s.

DeployBot: Gateway rule applied (no restart required). Canary remains at 5%. Next telemetry snapshot in 5m.

Jess: Thanks. I'll update the internal #release-notes thread and tag SDK owners so they can accelerate a patch in the next SDK minor.

Sam: I'll post the 5m/15m snapshots here. Everyone please thumbs-up when you're good with proceeding after the hold. :thumbsup:
